verdict.rationale: Evidence shows deep-crawl (BFS) and adaptive crawling features that limit or stop crawling, but these still involve fetching and parsing pages rather than instantly enumerating a site's URL list (e.g., via sitemap parsing) without crawling. No probe or doc confirms a dedicated 'discover URLs only' mode. Missing for 10: sitemap.xml/URL-discovery feature, evidence of URL enumeration without page fetches, independent confirmation of instant discovery.
